concept: Compute Optimizer: rightsizing by actual utilization
tests: Knowing the service that gives metric-based recommendations for downsizing instance types.
expected: AWS Compute Optimizer — ML analysis of CloudWatch metrics and optimal instance type recommendations. Triggers: "low CPU/memory utilization", "resize recommendations", "based on observed usage", "right-sizing".
why_not: Trusted Advisor service limits are about quotas, not rightsizing; CUR gives detailed billing lines with no recommendations; CloudWatch alarms react to thresholds but do not suggest types.
